newsitem.title: USA: BioTechnica unit to sell new seed hybrids.
newsitem.headline: BioTechnica unit to sell new seed hybrids.

text.p: LG Seeds Inc, a unit of BioTechnica International Inc, said Tuesday it will sell its latest biotechnology engineered seeds in 1997 -- Liberty Link Corn hybrids and Roundup Ready Soybean seed.

It said commercial agreements with AgrEvo for Liberty Link Corn, and Monsanto Co for Roundup Ready Soybeans, follow research agreements between LG Seeds' sister company, Limagrain Genetics Research, and the licensing companies.
Availability of seeds of both products is limited for this inaugural year, LG Seeds said.
LG Seeds produces and markets seeds throughout the U.S. Cornbelt.
